host.log.kind.ApiRequest.desc: History of requests to the VRChat API
host.log.kind.ApiRequest.locked: Not stored or shown while “Also store API requests” is off in Settings.
host.log.kind.raw.desc: Lines not recognized as events, shown as they are
host.log.level.WRN.desc: Something went wrong, but the app kept going
host.log.source.host.desc: VR / wrist / log reading, and more
host.settings.appLogKeepDays.description: How many days the app log is kept. Older logs are deleted at startup and when this changes. The log files for sharing (last 5 runs) are kept separately.
host.settings.appLogKeepDays.label: Days to keep the app log
host.settings.confirmSeconds.description: After this many seconds it is treated as "No". If you miss it, it still stays in the list.
host.settings.confirmSeconds.label: Seconds to show a prompt
host.settings.hiddenSidebarStatus.descri: Choose which module info is shown on the right of each sidebar row.
host.settings.hiddenSidebarStatus.label: Status shown in the sidebar
host.settings.hiddenWristItems.descripti: Change what is shown at the top of the wrist shortcut bar.
host.settings.hiddenWristItems.label: Shown at the top of the wrist shortcut bar
host.settings.hiddenWristNotes.descripti: Choose which kinds show in the notifications on the right of the wrist. Saved separately from the log screen's filter. Prompts waiting for an answer always show.
host.settings.hiddenWristNotes.label: Shown in the wrist notifications
host.settings.language.description: Auto follows the OS display language, or English when that language isn't available. Changes apply immediately (the tray menu only from the next start).
host.settings.language.label: Display language
host.settings.oscPort.description: The port VRChat receives OSC on. 9000 by default. Changes apply immediately.
host.settings.oscPort.label: VRChat OSC port
host.settings.switches.section.notify: Notifications (the ones at the bottom right)
host.settings.shortcuts.empty: No shortcuts yet. Drag one in from the list in the middle.
host.settings.shortcuts.note: Six per page on the wrist. Drag to move / × to remove.
host.settings.shortcuts.title: Wrist shortcuts
host.settings.storeAllLines.description: Storing every line goes past 15,000 lines per session. By default only lines recognized as events are stored.
host.settings.storeAllLines.label: Also store raw logs
host.settings.storeApiRequests.descripti: Requests to the VRChat API make up about 90% of the events and grow the record. While off, they are neither stored nor shown in the log, and neither are raw [API] lines (what is already stored stays).
host.settings.storeApiRequests.label: Also store API requests
host.settings.theme.description: Pick a color scheme. Loads themes/<name>/theme.css. The bundled dark / light are restored when the app updates, so to make your own, copy the directory, rename it, and edit the copy. Changes apply immediately.
host.settings.theme.label: Theme
host.settings.title: Host
host.settings.toastSeconds.description: How long a notification at the bottom right that needs no answer stays before it closes itself. Ones showing progress or with a button stay a little longer.
host.settings.toastSeconds.label: Seconds to show a notification
host.settings.vrWindowSpot.description: How the VR window opened from a wrist shortcut is placed (AboveWrist = attached above the wrist shortcut bar, moving with your arm and hiding with it / InFront = placed in front of you each time it opens). Takes effect the next time it opens. Point at the window and grip to move it; keep gripping, pull the trigger, and push your hand forward to shrink it or pull it back to enlarge it. A window on the wrist remembers where you moved it and its size.
host.settings.vrWindowSpot.label: VR window placement
host.settings.wristHand.description: Which wrist the wrist shortcut bar is on (Left = left hand, Right = right hand). It only shows while you look at that wrist.
host.settings.wristHand.label: Hand for the wrist shortcut bar
host.settings.wristHideBeyondDegrees.des: Once shown, the wrist shortcut bar hides when it is further than this from the center of your view (where your head points, in degrees). Keep it larger than the show angle so it does not flicker at the edge. A value below the show angle is treated as the show angle.
host.settings.wristLayoutLockSeconds.des: While you are changing the layout of the wrist shortcut bar and the VR window (🔓), it locks again once none of them has been pointed at or held for this many seconds. The controllers do not reach VRChat while the layout is being changed, so this keeps a forgotten Done from leaving you stuck. 0 keeps it unlocked until you press Done.
host.settings.wristLayoutLockSeconds.lab: Seconds before the layout locks itself
host.settings.wristShortcuts.description: Pressing one opens the VR window on that screen (press it again to close the window) or runs what a module offers. Use Arrange… to choose and order them. The SteamVR dashboard still opens from the SteamVR menu.
host.settings.wristShortcuts.label: Wrist shortcuts
host.settings.wristShowWithinDegrees.des: The wrist shortcut bar appears when it comes within this angle of the center of your view (where your head points, in degrees; 0 is dead center). The larger it is, the more a glance from the corner of your eye is enough. It never shows while turned away or edge-on. Changes apply immediately.
host.window.layoutHint: Clicks are disabled while you change the layout. Grip to move / keep gripping, press the trigger, and move your hand back and forth to resize.

host.module.dependency.hostTooOld: {0} is required, but this app has {1}, so the app needs to be updated
host.module.dependency.sdkTooOld: This module was built with an old SDK ({0}). Update it to {1} or later, or ask the developer to rebuild it with a newer SDK
host.modules.restartNeeded: Changes won't apply until a restart
host.modules.next.remove: Removed at the next start (its settings and records stay)
host.modules.reason.noEntry: No entry DLL was found (place *.deps.json or {0}.dll)
host.modules.restartFailed: Failed to restart. Restart the app manually
host.settings.showModuleAgreement.label: Show the agreement when adding a module
host.settings.showModuleAgreement.descri: After you enter a URL in "Add a module", asks you to agree that installing is at your own risk, among other things. Choosing "Don't show this screen again" there turns this off; turn it on to show the screen again. It is never shown for updates.
host.settings.checkModuleUpdates.label: Check for updates
host.settings.checkModuleUpdates.descrip: Checks once a day while the app is running whether modules installed from GitHub have a newer version. The check is automatic; updates are installed from the Modules screen.
host.settings.parallelModuleBuilds.label: Build modules in parallel
host.settings.parallelModuleBuilds.descr: When several modules are built from source, builds them at the same time. When off, they are built one at a time (downloads still run side by side).
host.settings.updateChannel.label: Update channel
host.settings.updateChannel.description: Which releases to get (Stable = releases only / Nightly = builds in development, out with every change to main; they may have bugs). Going back from Nightly to Stable offers the latest Stable release even though its version is lower.
host.settings.checkAppUpdates.label: Check for updates automatically
host.settings.checkAppUpdates.descriptio: Looks for a new version 20 seconds after the app starts and every 6 hours after that. It only looks: a new version is installed when you press "Update" in the notice at the top of the window. Works in the installed app only.
host.update.notInstalled: Only available in the installed app
host.update.switch: You changed the channel: you can switch to version {0}
host.update.installFailed: Couldn't update (the reason is in the app log)
host.modules.add.title: Add a module
host.modules.agree.lead: To continue, agree to the following
host.modules.agree.risk: I understand that installing a module is at my own risk
host.modules.agree.liability: I understand that the author of this software is not liable for any problems caused by installing a module
host.modules.menu.title: More actions
host.modules.next.update: Updated to {0} at the next start
host.modules.next.updateCommit: Updated to {0} (commit {1}) at the next start

host.modules.update.failed: Failed to check for updates (no response from GitHub)

host.modules.job.sdk.askNoSize: .NET SDK {0} or later is not installed on this PC. Download it?
host.modules.job.sdk.note: It is downloaded and run as a tool of this app only; nothing else on the PC is affected.
host.modules.job.install.note: This module runs with the current user's permissions. Make sure it comes from a developer you trust before installing. The installation completes after a restart.
